college_info.name: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kalyani
college_info.motto: विद्याधनं सर्वधनप्रधानम् (Knowledge is the supreme wealth)

about.description: IIIT Kalyani is an Institute of National Importance established by Ministry of Education, Government of India. The institute offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in Computer Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and related fields.
about.vision: To emerge as a center of excellence in Information Technology and allied areas through quality education, research, and innovation.
about.mission: To provide quality education and foster research in emerging areas of IT, to develop industry-ready professionals, and to contribute to societal development through innovation.
